fields.Name: Asana
fields.Description: Asana work-management connector. Syncs workspace users, projects, top-level tasks and subtasks over the Asana REST API v1.0 with a personal-access-token bearer credential. Read-only.

fields.Name: Users
fields.Description: Members of the Asana workspace. Read-only over the API.

fields.Name: gid
fields.Description: Asana global id of the user. Stable across the workspace and the primary key of this object.

fields.Name: name
fields.Description: The user's full display name as a single string. Asana stores no separate first/last name.

fields.Name: email
fields.Description: The user's email address. Visible only when the calling token has permission to see it.

fields.Name: resource_type
fields.Description: Asana resource type discriminator; always "user" for this object.

fields.Name: Projects
fields.Description: Projects in the Asana workspace. Read-only over the API.

fields.Name: gid
fields.Description: Asana global id of the project. Primary key of this object and the value substituted into the Tasks door.

fields.Name: name
fields.Description: Project name as shown in Asana.

fields.Name: resource_type
fields.Description: Asana resource type discriminator; always "project" for this object.

fields.Name: archived
fields.Description: True when the project has been archived in Asana.

fields.Name: color
fields.Description: Asana colour token for the project (e.g. "dark-blue"). Null when no colour is set.

fields.Name: icon
fields.Description: Asana icon token for the project (e.g. "chart"). Null when no icon is set.

fields.Name: notes
fields.Description: Free-text project description.

fields.Name: start_on
fields.Description: Project start date (date only). Null when unset.

fields.Name: due_on
fields.Description: Project due date (date only). Null when unset.

fields.Name: current_status_color
fields.Description: Colour of the latest status update ("green"/"yellow"/"red"), flattened from the nested current_status object.

fields.Name: current_status_title
fields.Description: Title of the latest status update, flattened from the nested current_status object.

fields.Name: current_status_text
fields.Description: Body text of the latest status update, flattened from the nested current_status object.

fields.Name: owner_gid
fields.Description: Gid of the project owner, flattened from the nested owner object. Null when the project has no owner.

fields.Name: team_gid
fields.Description: Gid of the owning team, flattened from the nested team object.

fields.Name: workspace_gid
fields.Description: Gid of the workspace the project belongs to, flattened from the nested workspace object.

fields.Name: permalink_url
fields.Description: Canonical Asana web URL for the project.

fields.Name: public
fields.Description: True when the project is visible to the whole team rather than only its members.

fields.Name: created_at
fields.Description: When the project was created in Asana.

fields.Name: modified_at
fields.Description: When the project was last modified in Asana.

fields.Name: Tasks
fields.Description: Top-level tasks, fetched one project at a time. Asana has no workspace-wide task listing, so this is a templated child door over Projects; subtasks are excluded here and sync as their own object.

fields.Name: gid
fields.Description: Asana global id of the task. Primary key of this object and the value substituted into the Subtasks door.

fields.Name: project_gid
fields.Description: Gid of the project this task was fetched under. Stamped by the engine from the parent record it iterated, not returned by Asana on the task itself.

fields.Name: name
fields.Description: Task title as shown in Asana.

fields.Name: resource_type
fields.Description: Asana resource type discriminator; always "task" for this object.

fields.Name: completed
fields.Description: True once the task has been marked complete.

fields.Name: completed_at
fields.Description: When the task was marked complete, or null while it is open.

fields.Name: assignee_gid
fields.Description: Gid of the assigned user, flattened from the nested assignee object. Null when unassigned.

fields.Name: parent_gid
fields.Description: Gid of this task's parent task, flattened from the nested parent object. Null for top-level tasks.

fields.Name: start_on
fields.Description: Start date (date only). Null when the task has no start date.

fields.Name: due_on
fields.Description: Due date (date only). Null when the task has no due date, or when it uses a due timestamp instead.

fields.Name: due_at
fields.Description: Due timestamp when the task carries a time-of-day deadline rather than a plain due date.

fields.Name: notes
fields.Description: Free-text task description.

fields.Name: permalink_url
fields.Description: Canonical Asana web URL for the task.

fields.Name: created_at
fields.Description: When the task was created in Asana.

fields.Name: modified_at
fields.Description: When the task was last modified in Asana. Drives incremental sync via modified_since.

fields.Name: section_name
fields.Description: Name of the section the task sits in, flattened from the first project membership. Null when the task is in no section.

fields.Name: custom_fields_json
fields.Description: The task's custom_fields array serialized as JSON. Custom fields are configured per workspace, so they cannot be declared as columns; downstream consumers project the ones they care about out of this blob.

fields.Name: Subtasks
fields.Description: Subtasks, fetched one parent task at a time. Asana returns the same task resource here as for a top-level task, so the shape matches Tasks with the parent scope stamped on.

fields.Name: gid
fields.Description: Asana global id of the subtask. Subtasks are tasks, so this shares the Tasks id space.

fields.Name: parent_task_gid
fields.Description: Gid of the task this subtask was fetched under. Stamped by the engine from the parent record it iterated.

fields.Name: name
fields.Description: Task title as shown in Asana.

fields.Name: resource_type
fields.Description: Asana resource type discriminator; always "task" for this object.

fields.Name: completed
fields.Description: True once the task has been marked complete.

fields.Name: completed_at
fields.Description: When the task was marked complete, or null while it is open.

fields.Name: assignee_gid
fields.Description: Gid of the assigned user, flattened from the nested assignee object. Null when unassigned.

fields.Name: parent_gid
fields.Description: Gid of this task's parent task, flattened from the nested parent object. Null for top-level tasks.

fields.Name: start_on
fields.Description: Start date (date only). Null when the task has no start date.

fields.Name: due_on
fields.Description: Due date (date only). Null when the task has no due date, or when it uses a due timestamp instead.

fields.Name: due_at
fields.Description: Due timestamp when the task carries a time-of-day deadline rather than a plain due date.

fields.Name: notes
fields.Description: Free-text task description.

fields.Name: permalink_url
fields.Description: Canonical Asana web URL for the task.

fields.Name: created_at
fields.Description: When the task was created in Asana.

fields.Name: modified_at
fields.Description: When the task was last modified in Asana. Drives incremental sync via modified_since.

fields.Name: section_name
fields.Description: Name of the section the task sits in, flattened from the first project membership. Null when the task is in no section.

fields.Name: custom_fields_json
fields.Description: The task's custom_fields array serialized as JSON. Custom fields are configured per workspace, so they cannot be declared as columns; downstream consumers project the ones they care about out of this blob.
